articles.title: GN: Woman Seriously Injured After Falling While Escaping Dog Attack in Eco Village-1 Society
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A distressing incident took place in the Eco Village-1 society of Greater Noida West’s Thana Bisrakh area on Sunday evening, leaving a woman critically injured. According to reports, the woman was walking on the society's podium when a pet dog suddenly charged at her.

body.html:
A distressing incident took place in the Eco Village-1 society of Greater Noida West’s Thana Bisrakh area on Sunday evening, leaving a woman critically injured.

According to reports, the woman was walking on the society's podium when a pet dog suddenly charged at her. In a panic to escape the animal, she lost her balance and fell from the podium. The fall caused serious injuries to her lower back. She was immediately rushed to a nearby hospital and later shifted to the Critical Care Unit (CCU) due to her deteriorating condition.

CCTV footage of the incident confirms the sequence of events, clearly showing the dog running towards the woman moments before she fell.

The incident sparked concern among residents, who have criticized the lack of control over pets in the society. Many are demanding stricter regulations to prevent such episodes, especially since similar concerns over stray and pet dog attacks have been raised in the past.

Although no police complaint has been filed yet, residents are calling for accountability and action to ensure the safety of people—particularly the elderly and children—within residential complexes.

articles.title: "We have not hit Kirana Hills": Air Marshal A.K. Bharti's Subtle Response Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a sharp yet composed statement, Air Marshal A.K. Bharti responded to claims about an alleged strike on Kirana Hills, saying, "Thank you for telling us Kirana Hills houses some nuclear installation, we didn’t know.

body.html:
In a sharp yet composed statement, Air Marshal A.K. Bharti responded to claims about an alleged strike on Kirana Hills, saying, "Thank you for telling us Kirana Hills houses some nuclear installation, we didn’t know. We have not hit Kirana Hills."

What caught public attention was not just the words—but the smirk and confident body language that followed. The Air Marshal's demeanor has sparked widespread interest online, with many interpreting it as a message that needed no further elaboration.

Social media users are hailing the moment as a masterclass in diplomatic subtlety and strategic messaging.

articles.title: Unnao: Family of Four Found Dead, Love Affair Suspected Behind Tragedy
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A heartbreaking incident in Unnao has left the community stunned, as a husband, wife, and their two children were found dead under suspicious circumstances. Initial investigations suggest the tragedy may be linked to a love affair.

body.html:
A heartbreaking incident in Unnao has left the community stunned, as a husband, wife, and their two children were found dead under suspicious circumstances. Initial investigations suggest the tragedy may be linked to a love affair.

An emotional audio clip recovered by police features the husband saying, “I love my wife and children very much. Wherever we go, we’ll go together.” He also mourned his daughter, saying, “She was a piece of my heart.”

Police suspect the man was devastated after learning of his wife's alleged affair with a neighbour, possibly prompting the drastic act. Investigations are ongoing, with audio evidence being closely examined.

articles.title: Shahjahanpur: Fake Terror Attack Video Circulated, FIR Filed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: False information about a terrorist attack in Shahjahanpur, Uttar Pradesh, was spread through social media. A Facebook ID created in the name of SP MP Aditya Yadav shared a fake video of gunfire.

body.html:
False information about a terrorist attack in Shahjahanpur, Uttar Pradesh, was spread through social media. A Facebook ID created in the name of SP MP Aditya Yadav shared a fake video of gunfire. Police have registered an FIR against Facebook user Parvinder and Instagram user Ankit Kumar for spreading misinformation.

articles.title: Unnao: Father’s Crying Video Over Missing Daughter Goes Viral, Alleges Police Negligence
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video of a man crying inside Unnao’s Sadar police station has gone viral, in which he accuses the police of negligence after his daughter went missing on May 6, shortly after returning from school.

body.html:
A video of a man crying inside Unnao’s Sadar police station has gone viral, in which he accuses the police of negligence after his daughter went missing on May 6, shortly after returning from school. He claims police are making him shuttle between the police station and outposts without action.

Unnao Police stated that FIR No. 349/25 has been registered at Kotwali Sadar under relevant sections, and efforts are underway to safely recover the girl.

articles.title: Lucknow: Fire Breaks Out in Rajajipuram House, No Casualties Reported
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A fire broke out on the second floor of Harsh Mahi Sadan in Gayatripuram, Rajajipuram, Lucknow. The blaze reportedly started from a lamp burning in the house temple. Two fire engines were deployed, and the fire was brought under control with the help of Thana Para police.

body.html:
A fire broke out on the second floor of Harsh Mahi Sadan in Gayatripuram, Rajajipuram, Lucknow. The blaze reportedly started from a lamp burning in the house temple.

Two fire engines were deployed, and the fire was brought under control with the help of Thana Para police. According to Lucknow Police, the fire has been fully extinguished and no loss of life was reported. Emergency teams remain on alert at the scene.
